title: fix(ui): an empty report index points at the apps that have reports
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoDnVj7S3St12zLfDBXSN5gF)_

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：某个应用的报表首页没有任何可看的报表时（例如 Setup 的「All reports」），除了「This app has no reports you can open.」，现在还会列出你有报表可看的其它应用，每个都链接到该应用自己的报表首页。
- 为什么改：#27356 第 11 行（hotcrm#2320 Setup S11）：HotCRM 浏览器走查指出 Setup 的 All reports 是一个死胡同。
- 风险与回滚：只在报表首页为空时多出一组链接；有报表的首页完全不变；侧栏入口保持静态，不做隐藏。新增一个文案键，10 个语言包都有。回滚就是 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`appReportIndex.ts` 的 `useOtherAppsWithReports` 与 `AppReportIndexView.tsx` 空状态里的 `report-index-other-apps`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/__tests__/AppReportIndex.otherApps-27356.test.tsx`，应见 2 passed。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

Fixes #27356
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What changes

- **An empty report index points somewhere.** `AppReportIndexView`'s empty state (Setup's All reports is the case HotCRM hit) keeps its title and "This app has no reports you can open.", and under it now lists, as links, the other apps whose own index has a report for the reader: "Reports in your other apps:" followed by one chip per app linking to `/apps/APP/reports`. The app's name is its served, localized label.
- **Which apps.** The new `useOtherAppsWithReports` (`appReportIndex.ts`) keeps a launcher app when it is not the current app and `appShippedReports` gives it at least one report `mayOpenReport` lets the member read: the same served report list and read rule `useAppReportEntries` uses for the index itself. Each app's index still applies that app's navigation gates when it opens. While the report or dataset list is still loading it returns nothing, so no link flickers in.
- **The sidebar entry stays static.** Hiding All reports in an app with no reports was the other reading of the row; it is not taken, because the index is also the route the ⌘K palette and links land on.
- One new key, `console.reportIndex.otherApps`, in all ten locale packs.

## Tests

- New `AppReportIndex.otherApps-27356.test.tsx` (2 tests), on the real `MetadataProvider` (a fake adapter answers `/meta/:type`), `MePermissionsProvider`, `ExpressionProvider` and `I18nProvider`, the harness of `AppReportIndex-13020`:
  - Setup's empty index lists CRM (a report the member may read) with href `/apps/com.example.crm/reports`, and not People (its only report reads an object the member may not read), Notes (no report) or Setup itself;
  - CONTROL: CRM's own index lists its reports and draws no other-apps links.

<details><summary>Readings (head c2241b20, base origin/main 39da1bd6 unless marked; the same commit was first measured as 7b81b623 on 3a2f4c00)</summary>

- New file: 2/2 passed.
- Every ui test file naming `appReportIndex`, `AppReportIndexView` or `reportIndex` (10 files): 10 passed, 171/171 tests.
- `pnpm --dir ui --filter @object-ui/i18n --filter @object-ui/app-shell run type-check` (both programs each, both scripts echoed): lock VERDICT command-exit 0 on 7b81b623 (the main commits between the two bases touch none of the files this diff edits or imports from app-shell/i18n; the re-run on c2241b20 is reported in the os-dev-report comment).
- Ablation (on 7b81b623), through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`: the read rule `appShippedReports(reports, app).some((report) => mayOpenReport(report, datasetObjects, can)),` to `appShippedReports(reports, app).length > 0,`: 1 failed / 1 passed (People is offered; the control stays green); restored blob = HEAD blob `d4e7c01cfe47`, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- vitest resolves `@object-ui/*` to source, so the ablation needed no rebuild leg.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Per-row status of #27356's Setup rows** (the Studio rows 12–22 are settled, handoff 6524323618):

  | Row | Disposition |
  |---|---|
  | 5 | **Landed** in #28197 (Setup metadata lists take their title from the sidebar and lead with the label). |
  | 11 | **Taken here.** |
  | 10 | **Will not do on this card.** HotCRM saw Export under Display at 1440 px, not only at phone width: the bundled Display panel with Refresh and Export in its footer is the default at every width by objectui#12423's maintainer-approved design. Moving Export back to the bar or the ⋯ menu reverses that design and needs a maintainer call. |
  | 1 | The seat files or screens out the `domain:server` finding: Create User's params are server metadata (`create_user` on `sys_user`, platform-objects; `permissionSet` is an inline `type: 'text'` param) and the create-user door accepts no position. |
  | 4 | The seat files or screens out the `domain:server` finding: `POST /automation/:name/trigger` refuses a `runAs: 'system'` schedule flow for anyone but the system principal (`flowStartRefusal`); all of HotCRM's schedule flows run as system. |
  | 6 | The seat files or screens out the `domain:server` finding: the Users row menu is `sys_user`'s server actions; there is no deactivate verb, only Ban. |
  | 7 | The seat files or screens out the `domain:server` finding: "Record ID" is `sys_approval_request`'s own field label (plugin-approvals). |
  | 8 | The seat files or screens out the `domain:server` finding: plugin-approvals knows a request opened on its fallback approvers but persists no marker a reader can show. |

  Every Setup row is landed or answered, so this PR closes the card.
- An app counts by its shipped reports and the read rule only; an app whose reports are all hidden by its own navigation gates is still offered, and its index then shows its own empty state. Gating every other app's navigation from here would read every app's gates on one page.
- Measured in happy-dom, not in a browser.

## Verification

On 7b81b623: `dispatch-gates --commands` derived 34 families for this diff; all 34 were run locally with stdin closed, each exit 0, and `--ran` reconciled 34 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. On c2241b20 the derivation is the identical 34-line list; its re-run is reported in the os-dev-report comment. `check:new-line-citations`: 0 new (report-only gate). 209 changed lines.

The harness's after-PR assign and review-request step is skipped on the order's word (the seat lands).
